source: S4 P49/P56/P90 with 2026-10-16 user override: no initial key placement; first genuine completion uses deferred uniform discovery among sampled targets
status: Source-consistent discovery policy; not a measured whole-level clear-rate claim
probability_policy: 1 / remaining uncompleted eligible initial targets; final eligible completion guarantees discovery in L1-L4
recent_result_policy: Implementation choice for repeated-location feedback: exclude the latest actual result only from the immediately next attempt's sample when other legal candidates can fill the required count; never remove world points or block CONTROL
interference_scope: Facts only. Cancellation, cat/NPC interruption, time and mental-state consequences remain in existing rules; no additional key-probability penalty
out_of_group_policy: Legal CONTROL and L4 supplemental searches keep normal action/reward semantics but do not widen the initial eligible key set
legacy_l4_recovery_policy: Only migrating a v1 L4 save with all sixteen initial points already empty and no discovered key: preserve those verdicts, expose unfinished legal supplemental points as migration_recovery_targets, and discover only on genuine completion with the final remaining recovery point guaranteed. This is save compatibility, not a new-attempt rule.
